name: Save Page as Markdown or PDF
pitch: Save the current page as clean Markdown or a print-ready PDF. Runs locally — nothing is uploaded.

permissions.name: activeTab
permissions.reason: Read the current page only after the user clicks Save — no access to any other page or at any other time.

permissions.name: scripting
permissions.reason: Run the article extractor in the current tab when the user clicks Save (allowed by activeTab; no host permissions).

permissions.name: storage
permissions.reason: Pass the extracted article from the popup to the extension's own print page via session storage; deleted as soon as the print page reads it.
